name: Makigami Matrix
description: Swim-lane process analysis with processing/waiting times and waste classification
whenToUse: When a cross-department process is to be recorded step by step with responsibility, processing time, waiting time and waste categories so that idle time becomes visible; not for the flow logic itself with its decisions and branches, which is what a flowchart is for.
title: Process title
rolesEmpty: No roles yet – add one via the "Role" button.
stepsEmpty: No steps yet – add one via the "Step" button.
kpiPCEHint: Process Cycle Efficiency = Σ Processing / Lead Time
settingsUnitsHint: The seconds factor controls how the free-text parser converts each unit (e.g. 1 d = 28800 s ≙ 8-hour workday).

confirm.removeRole: Delete role "{label}"? Participation in all steps will be removed.
confirm.removeRoleUnnamed: Delete the unnamed role? Participation in all steps will be removed.
confirm.resetSettings: Really reset all categories and units to defaults?

hints.lastMuda: The last waste category cannot be deleted.
hints.lastUnit: The last time unit cannot be deleted.

invariants.uniqueIds: Every role, step, waste category and time unit has its own non-empty identifier.
invariants.mudaNotEmpty: There is always at least one waste category.
invariants.unitsNotEmpty: There is always at least one time unit.
invariants.knownRefs: A step only refers to existing roles and existing waste categories.
invariants.knownCollapsed: Only the card of an existing step can be collapsed.
invariants.mudaColorHex: The colour of a waste category is a hex value in the format #rrggbb, such as #4a90e2.
